ItemID: NA; Title: Decemberunderground; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic, heavier rock appeal fits some of my listening, but other albums here interest me more today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pearl Jam; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my rock interests, though I am leaning toward heavier or more progressive music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes another Tool album my strongest choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Demonic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough confidence that this matches the heavy music I enjoy.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of melody, heavy riffs, and elaborate guitar work fits my interest in melodic metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iv; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This title is too ambiguous for me to connect it confidently with my current interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Matter Of Life And Death; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The expansive metal sound appeals, but I would prioritize the Tool and Opeth albums this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ghost Reveries; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its heavy passages and progressive arrangements connect well with my interest in In Flames and Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Every Man For Himself; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having listened to The Reason, I would be interested in another Hoobastank album with melodic rock hooks.
ItemID: NA; Title: Year Zero; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in guitar-driven rock and metal today than an industrial electronic direction.
